description: Pair-level scan configuration for Unichain mainnet. Wave 7 question: does Unichain (Uniswap's own L2) contain a non-Uniswap counterpart of sufficient depth to qualify as an arbitrage surface? Discovery will identify all UniV3 pools and report depths. Non-Uniswap counterparts (Velodrome, DYORSwap, UniChainSwap from external research) will be added in wave7(commit 2) after on-chain factory verification. Constitutional discipline: discovery runs regardless of DexScreener depth signals — TVL is not behavioral profile, surprises happen.
